name: Infrared Transmitter

steps.text: Plug the IR emitter plug into IRLinc's emitter jack. Don't cut off either emitter, or the other one will stop working.
Plug IRLinc into a convenient, unswitched wall outlet near your IR equipment. You need access to the bottom of IRLinc during setup, so you may want to use an extension cord temporarily.
steps.expect: Status LED turns on solid blue

steps.text: Locate the IR sensor on the device you want to control and hold the emitter where you intend to mount it.
Double-tap the SET button on IRLinc.
steps.expect: IRLinc double-beeps and its status LED begins blinking

steps.text: Point your IR remote at the bottom of IRLinc, within a couple of inches of its IR sensor, and tap the button to be learned.
steps.expect: IRLinc double-beeps and its status LED turns on solid; if it beeps eight times, remount the emitter and start over

steps.text: Test the learned code by tapping the SET button on IRLinc.
steps.expect: IRLinc beeps and the IR-controlled device responds

steps.text: Remove the peel-off backing from the first IR emitter and mount it over the device's IR sensor.
Repeat the learning and mounting steps for the second IR emitter.

notes: To create a macro (one Insteon command sending several IR commands), learn another code and link again.
Avoid using the pass-through outlet for stacking Insteon devices or for other heat-generating power supplies.
Don't plug IRLinc into a switched outlet or a filtered power strip.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button on IRLinc until it double-beeps (3 seconds).
steps.expect: IRLinc double-beeps, and after a few seconds double-beeps again

steps.text: Don't proceed until you hear two sets of double-beeps.
Optionally, to have the IR code respond to an off command instead of on, send an off command from the controller within 30 seconds.
Confirm the link by tapping the button you just linked on the controller.

notes: IRLinc Transmitter links as a responder. Put the controller in linking mode first (for most controllers, press and hold an On or scene button for 10 seconds, or the SET button for 3 seconds); you then have 4 minutes to put IRLinc in linking mode.
IRLinc responds only to Insteon on and off commands; the IR commands for on and off are independent.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button on IRLinc until it double-beeps (3 seconds).
steps.expect: IRLinc double-beeps, and after a few seconds double-beeps again

steps.text: Tap the button you unlinked on the controller to confirm.

notes: Put the controller in unlinking mode first (for most controllers, press and hold an On or scene button for 10 seconds twice, or the SET button for 3 seconds twice); you then have 4 minutes.

steps.text: If a controller controls IRLinc, unlink IRLinc from it.
Unplug IRLinc from the outlet.
Wait 10 seconds.
While holding down the SET button, plug IRLinc back in, making sure not to let go of the SET button.
Continue to hold down the SET button for 3 seconds.
Release the SET button.
steps.expect: A few seconds after release, IRLinc beeps and the status LED turns on solid

steps.text: Unlink IRLinc from every controller linked to it; otherwise the controllers retry their commands and slow down the system.

sources: Insteon Device Categories and Product Keys (October 2008)
